method_summary: Direct page retrieval (WebFetch and curl) was EGRESS_BLOCKED for every vendor domain tried: workspace.google.com, knowledge.workspace.google.com, support.google.com, supabase.com, www.brevo.com, help.brevo.com, stripe.com, n8n.io, docs.n8n.io, vercel.com, calendly.com, backblaze.com, hetzner.com, docs.hetzner.com, developers.cloudflare.com, bunny.net, docs.bunny.net, remotion.dev, remotion.pro, facebook.com. raw.githubusercontent.com was reachable, so 'fetched' items come from vendors' own public GitHub source files (Supabase pricing data, Cloudflare docs, n8n LICENSE.md, Remotion LICENSE.md and pricing component). Every other item is 'snippet-only': the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, unverified. These are list prices, not quotes, and exclude taxes (GST/QST).

items.quote: Business Starter is priced at $7 per user per month with an annual 1-year commitment (saving 16%), or $8.40 per user per month for flexible billing.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. Direct fetch of workspace.google.com, knowledge.workspace.google.com and support.google.com was blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED). A separate result attributed to Google's Flexible Plan help page said 'Business Starter costs $8.40 USD per user per month' on the Flexible Plan. The query named the figures, so the summary may echo them. Source S4 already noted that the regional link showed USD.

items.quote: Business Standard is $14 per user per month with an annual commitment, or $16.80 per user per month for flexible billing.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. Another search (third-party sites, e.g. emailvendorselection.com, cloudwards.net) gave the same figures: '$16.80 per user per month when billed monthly and $14 per user per month with a 1-year commitment'. The query named the figures. Unverified.

items.quote: At the time of this August 2026 review, Google's Canadian page lists Business Starter at $9.20 CAD per user per month with a one-year commitment, Business Standard at $18.40, and Business Plus at $28.70. ... start at $9.20 CAD per user per month with a one-year commitment, or $11 on flexible billing.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. THIRD-PARTY source (a North Star IT reseller blog), not Google. The Standard Flexible figure (CAD 22) came from an earlier search summary ('Business Standard costs $18.40 CAD per user per month with a one-year commitment... flexible plan priced at $22') that cited no single source. Confirm CAD in Bill's own Google checkout.

items.price: Starter: 100 participants, no recording; Standard: 150 participants, with recording
items.quote: Business Starter plans support video meetings with 100 participants, while Business Standard plans include video meetings with recording, noise cancellation, and support for 150 participants.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. This matches source S4 (Standard = 150 participants + recording). Recording is 'not on Starter' by inference from the summary and a Google community thread titled 'Can I record using google meet using the Business starter package'. Not verified on a page.

items.price: Single booking page: no paid tier needed (personal account or Business Starter); premium features (multiple booking pages, payments via Stripe, email reminders, verified bookings) need Business Standard or higher
items.quote: With a personal Google Account or Workspace Business Starter plan, you can create a single booking page to let others schedule appointments on your calendar. ... By signing up for a Google Workspace Business Standard, Business Plus, or Enterprise plan, you can unlock premium features including payment collection, unlimited booking pages, automated email reminders, and verified bookings.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. Direct fetch of support.google.com was blocked.

items.currency: $ (Supabase bills in USD; the source file shows only '$')
items.quote: '500 MB database size', 'Shared CPU • 500 MB RAM' / '5 GB egress' / '5 GB cached egress' / '1 GB file storage' / footer: 'Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity. Limit of 2 active projects.' / pricing.ts: 'Automatic backups' free: false; 'Pausing' free: 'After 1 week of inactivity'
items.notes: supabase.com itself was blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED for WebFetch and curl). We fetched Supabase's public GitHub data files, which feed the pricing page (master branch, 2026-09-30). This matches a WebSearch snippet from supabase.com: '500 MB database size... free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity'. Also listed: 50,000 MAU and unlimited API requests. No automatic backups on Free, as source S2 says.

items.currency: $ (Supabase bills in USD; the source file shows only '$')
items.unit: per month (organization), includes one project on Micro compute
items.quote: priceLabel: 'From', priceMonthly: 25, warning: 'Includes one project running on Micro compute.' ... '8 GB disk size per project', 'then $0.125 per GB' / '250 GB egress', 'then $0.09 per GB' / '100 GB file storage', 'then $0.0213 per GB' / 'Daily backups stored for 7 days' / pricing.ts 'Pausing' pro: 'Never'
items.notes: Pro adds daily backups (7-day retention), no pausing, email support and 7-day log retention. A WebSearch snippet (supabase.com docs) adds: 'Paid plans include $10/month in compute credits, which covers one Micro instance.' That line is snippet-only. Point-in-time recovery is an add-on: '$100 per month per 7 days retention' (pricing.ts).

items.quote: The Free plan includes 300 daily email sends and storage for up to 100,000 contacts. The Free plan is completely free forever with no credit card required and no time limit.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. www.brevo.com and help.brevo.com were blocked. The 300/day figure matches source S11. The '100,000 contacts' figure is unverified: a Brevo community thread title mentions 5,000 contacts on Free.

items.currency: USD (as stated in the snippet; not verified for a Canadian locale)
items.quote: The Starter plan starts at $9 per month. ... includes no daily sending limit, with availability in multiple tiers ... / the Brevo Starter plan includes 5,000 emails per month for $9 USD monthly.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. Brevo prices by monthly email volume, so higher volumes cost more. The currency may change with the visitor's locale. Uncertain.

items.quote: The base rate for card payments in Canada is 2.9% + CA$0.30 per successful charge.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. stripe.com and support.stripe.com were blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED).

items.unit: per transaction, on top of the base rate
items.quote: For international cards, there is an additional 0.8% fee, plus 2% if currency conversion is required.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. The query named the figures. A second search (query without 0.8% alone) confirmed only the 2% conversion fee. Treat 0.8% as unverified.

items.quote: For international transactions with Stripe in Canada, there is an additional 2% fee if currency conversion is required.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. Adaptive Pricing has a separate conversion fee ('2–4%', per the snippet from docs.stripe.com). This does not apply if Bill charges CAD to Canadian cards.

items.quote: Stripe does not charge setup fees, monthly fees, or any other hidden fees like closure fees.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us.

items.quote: ## Sustainable Use License Version 1.0 ... The licensor grants you a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide, non-sublicensable, non-transferable license ... You may use or modify the software only for your own internal business purposes or for non-commercial or personal use. You may distribute the software or provide it to others only if you do so free of charge for non-commercial purposes.
items.notes: The licence text was fetched from n8n's GitHub repo (master). Files with '.ee.' in the name need an Enterprise licence. docs.n8n.io was blocked. Snippet-only, unverified (from the docs licence page): 'In practice this means all use is allowed unless you are selling a product, service, or module in which the value derives entirely or substantially from n8n functionality.' Running Bill's own lead and email automations counts as internal business use. It is not legal advice; license@n8n.io handles licence questions.

items.plan: Cloud Starter (reference only: the cost self-hosting avoids)
items.currency: $ (as shown in snippet; n8n may display EUR by region, unverified)
items.quote: The n8n Starter plan costs $20/month billed annually for 2,500 workflow executions per month. It's hosted by n8n and includes five concurrent executions, one shared project, and unlimited users.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. n8n.io was blocked. The monthly-billing price was not captured.

items.unit: per paid seat (Owner/Member) per month; includes $20 monthly usage credit
items.billing: monthly, plus usage beyond included credit
items.quote: Every Pro plan has $20 in monthly credit ... Additional paid seats (Owner or Member roles) cost $20/month each ... Developer seats cost $20 per user / month, while Viewer seats are free
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. vercel.com was blocked. Hobby is free but 'for personal, non-commercial use' (snippet), as source S1 says. Only relevant if the owner picks Vercel over the VPS.

items.price: 10 (billed yearly) / 12 (billed monthly) - CONFLICTING: one result said 16 billed yearly
items.quote: The Standard Plan costs $10/seat/month billed annually or $12/seat/month billed monthly. ... For the Teams plan ... $20 per seat monthly with monthly billing, and $16 per seat monthly with annual billing. / (conflicting summary) The Standard plan costs $16 per seat per month when billed yearly.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. calendly.com was blocked. The 10/12 figures come from third-party 2026 guides (zeeg.me, schedulingkit.com and others). $16 may be the Teams yearly price mislabelled. UNCERTAIN: best checked on Bill's current Calendly invoice, since this is an existing cost.

items.quote: Backblaze B2 is billed monthly at a rate of $6.95/TB/30-days for pay-as-you-go customers. ... free egress up to 3x their average monthly storage, with egress beyond 3x priced at just $0.01/GB.

items.plan: EXAMPLE (not a selection): video storage + delivery
items.price: Storage 0.01 per GB per region; delivery Volume tier 0.005 per GB (5 per TB); Standard tier about 0.01 per GB (region-based, unverified); 1 minimum monthly
items.quote: storage is $0.01/GB per storage region for up to two regions, and $0.005/GB per additional region ... The Volume tier offers a flat rate of $5 per TB served, which equals $0.005 per GB ... Accounts are subject to a $1 minimum monthly usage.

items.price: Free for individuals and for-profit organizations with up to 3 employees; Company License: 'Remotion for Creators' $25/mo per seat, 'Remotion for Automators' $0.01 per render with a $100/mo minimum; Enterprise from $500/month
items.unit: per seat per month / per render
items.quote: You are eligible to use Remotion for free if you are: an individual / a for-profit organization with up to 3 employees / a non-profit or not-for-profit organization / evaluating ... ; FreePricing.tsx: 'For individuals and companies of up to 3 people' ... 'Required for collaborations and companies of 4+ people' ... '$25/mo per seat' ... '$0.01 per render, $100/mo minimum' ... 'Starting at $500 per month'
items.notes: Fetched from Remotion's GitHub repo (main branch; LICENSE.md and the React source of the pricing page), because remotion.dev and remotion.pro were blocked. LICENSE.md says 'In Remotion 5.0, the license will slightly change', while this repo's film/ uses remotion 4.0.529. Whether the Free License applies depends on the size of the entity making the video (Arnaud's firm or Bill's firm, up to 3 people). The owner confirms this. Not legal advice.

items.price: Recommended start 'at least $5' per day over more than 6 days (currency not stated); no CAD-specific minimum found
items.quote: The recommended practice is to start with at least $5 for your budget and to choose a duration over six days. ... Minimum budgets are calculated as a daily amount, but apply whether an ad set is using a daily or lifetime budget.
items.notes: Snippet-only, unverified: text is the WebSearch tool's summary of search results, not a page retrieved by us. facebook.com was blocked. The plan's CAD 20/day for 14 days (CAD 280 total) is above this recommended starting point and longer than 6 days, so we found no conflict. Meta sets actual minimums per account currency and shows them in Ads Manager, so confirm there. The plan's figures are unchanged.
